evidence.activity: Company-run training programs for employees, partners and customers
evidence.quote: During fiscal 2026, our employees, partners and customers participated in over 3,400 training programs, representing over 219,000 training hours.
evidence.indicators: over 3,400 training programs, over 219,000 training hours

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size; the figure also covers partners and customers but gives no breakdown, so it is treated conservatively

evidence.activity: Paid Education Services offering product training content, certifications and an On-Demand Learning Library
evidence.quote: We offer training content for learners at all levels, with basic, intermediate, and expert certifications available.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Professional & Customer Support Services > Education Services

community.criterion: level 2: specific current education offering, limited in reach (training on the company's own products, no revenue or learner figures disclosed)

evidence.activity: Sells cyber resilience software to small and mid-sized businesses among other customers
evidence.quote: We serve a broad and diverse global customer base that includes large enterprises, small and mid‑sized businesses, and government agencies.

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 1: small-business customers with no specific enabling service

creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers data protection and cyber resilience software only; 'design' refers to engineering and architecture design, which is a trap.

community.reason: Level 2: the company runs specific current training activity (3,400+ programs and certification-based Education Services), but it is mainly training on its own products, with no measured external education or community investment, and when torn the lower level applies.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 1, based on general language only: the Community and Belonging section gives inclusive-workplace and diverse-pipeline statements with no specific practices, and coverage is insufficient under condition 2 because the relevant discussion is under about 150 words.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: small and mid-sized businesses are customers, but the filing describes no specific service aimed at founders' or small businesses' barriers.

ai.notes: The Item 7 excerpt mentions 'customer education' within other services revenue. It is the same activity as E2, so it is not counted again, and no education revenue figure is broken out. E1's training figure combines employees, partners and customers without a split, so it is tagged conservatively as employee development. Cross-cultural coverage is insufficient (condition 2), which triggers the automated sustainability-report second look. Global 24/7 support locations and international employee share (64%) count as international operations only and do not count. Indicative total before second look: 0 + 12 + 4 + 3 = 19/100.
